puntos.texto: Overshoot Day if everyone lived like Qatar

turnos.t: In 2026 humanity used nature about 73 per cent faster than ecosystems regenerate: about 1.73 Earths. Overshoot Day fell on 30 July. Living like Qatar, it would be 4 February; like Spain, 4 June. And the limitation: it's an estimate, and the 2026 date moved later mainly because of data revisions, not real improvement. One more data rule: keep observation and deduction apart, and check the y-axis scales.
